clips.name: glitch
clips.alt: The dancer turning, original left and with Glitch right: in short bursts rows of the picture tear sideways with red, green and blue fringes and square blocks jump, with clean frames in between
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: Intensity 0.75, Density 0.45 – bursts with clean frames between.

clips.name: crt-screen
clips.alt: CRT Screen on the dancing figure. Left: the whole frame, bulging, with rounded corners and a faint darker band rolling down. Right: part of the dancer enlarged three times, drawn in horizontal lines with fine red, green and blue stripes
clips.caption: CRT Screen, Flicker 0.8. Left: the whole frame. Right: enlarged 3× pixel for pixel.

clips.name: film-prism
clips.alt: Film Prism on the dancing figure. Left: the whole frame with coloured edges. Right: the middle of the stage, where she dances, enlarged twice: the white dress gains a red edge on one side and a blue-green edge on the other, and fine grain moves over the picture
clips.caption: Fringe 1, Prism shape, Grain 0.4. Left: the whole frame. Right: the middle of the stage enlarged 2× pixel for pixel; the grain moves.

clips.name: analog-signal-lab
clips.alt: The dancer, original left and through Analog Signal Lab as a worn VHS tape right: softer, warm cream colours kept, noise streaks crawling through the dark background and along the bottom edge where the video heads switch
clips.caption: Left: original. Right: a worn VHS tape (RF / Antenna Stage 0, VHS Stage 1, Tape Speed LP, Tracking Error 0.3).

clips.name: add-glitch
clips.alt: Screen recording: the pointer clicks + Add Effect in Properties, Effects, types glitch and clicks the Glitch tile; the Glitch card appears, the pointer drags its Density slider to 1 and the preview of the dancer breaks up
clips.caption: Adding Glitch: + Add Effect, type glitch, click the tile, drag Density.
